summary: HDFC Bank Limited, through its GIFT City Branch, filed a Form 6-K to disclose the completed issuance of US$1,750 million senior unsecured fixed-rate notes in two tranches: US$500 million 3-year notes at 5.159% and US$1,250 million 5-year notes at 5.401%, both settling August 26, 2026. The notes are unsecured, rated Baa3/BBB, listed on India INX and NSE-IX, and issued under 144A/Regulation S. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
